name: La Chapelle-d'Abondance
description: La Chapelle d'Abondance sits in the Abondance valley, part of the Chablais massif. As the starting point of the Portes du Soleil domain, it offers direct access to Châtel and Abondance. 22 lifts, 75km of runs with exceptional cross-country skiing — one of the best Nordic areas in Haute-Savoie. Snowshoeing, dog sledding, biathlon. A quiet, traditional base for accessing the 600km Portes du Soleil. Sunny aspect, authentic village atmosphere.

overview.atmosphere: Traditional village resort at the starting point of the Portes du Soleil. Linked to Châtel and Abondance. 75km runs — one of the finest cross-country areas in Haute-Savoie. Wild, sunny, authentic.

honest_drawbacks: Lower altitude — snow variable at valley level
Small local ski area (75km) — need PDS pass for full domain
Limited non-ski activities compared to larger resorts
